condition.coffee_leaf_rust.label: Possible coffee leaf rust
condition.undetermined.label: Condition not determined
condition.unsupported_crop.label: Unsupported crop
uncertainty.supported: Image signals are consistent with coffee leaf rust (evidence score {score}). This is not a laboratory-confirmed diagnosis.
uncertainty.needs_review: Some signals resemble coffee leaf rust (evidence score {score}), but they are not specific enough. Similar spots can have other causes.
uncertainty.abstain: Signals are too weak or unrecognised to suggest a condition (evidence score {score}). No diagnosis is offered.
uncertainty.unsupported_crop: Crop '{crop}' is not covered. Supported crops: {supported}.
scouting.inspect_lower_canopy_undersides: Inspect the undersides of lower-canopy leaves first; look for yellow-orange powder below yellow spots.
scouting.photograph_both_leaf_surfaces: Photograph the whole plant and both the upper and lower surface of suspect leaves.
scouting.check_wet_leaf_edges_tips: Check leaf edges and tips where water collects; spots often start there.
scouting.walk_priority_points: Walk the marked priority points, starting with the highest rank, and record what you find at each.
scouting.point: Priority point {rank}: about {distance_m} m {bearing} of the reported plant.
scouting.point_origin: Priority point {rank}: the reported plant and its immediate neighbours.
recommendation.flag_area_limit_movement: Mark the affected area and avoid moving leaves, plant material, soil or tools out of it.
recommendation.sanitize_clothing_tools: After visiting affected trees, wash clothing and clean footwear and tools before entering other plots.
recommendation.rescout_after_latent_peri: Plan to re-inspect in 4-6 weeks: lesions from recent infections appear after this delay.
recommendation.consult_extension_before_: Before any fungicide use, consult your local extension officer; follow the product label exactly.
recommendation.remove_feral_coffee_weeds: Remove unmanaged (feral) coffee plants and competing weeds near the plot.
recommendation.consider_resistant_cultiv: For future planting, ask about rust-resistant coffee varieties suited to your area.
recommendation.retake_photo: Take a clearer photo of the leaf underside in daylight and analyse again.
recommendation.seek_local_review: Ask a local agricultural officer to review the photos before acting.
risk.class.low: Recent and forecast weather was rarely favourable for rust infection.
risk.class.moderate: Recent or forecast weather was sometimes favourable for rust infection.
risk.class.high: Recent or forecast weather was often favourable for rust infection (warm and wet periods).
risk.unavailable: Weather data unavailable; infection-favourability could not be assessed.
review.reason.needs_review: Evidence is not specific; an expert should confirm before decisions.
review.reason.supported: Confirmation by an agricultural officer is advised before treatment decisions.
review.reason.high_weather: Weather has been favourable; early confirmation helps limit spread.
map.limitations: Relative scouting priority (0-1) around reported points; not an infection probability. Uncalibrated distance decay and wind stretch.
map.no_location: No location supplied; map and scouting points unavailable.
risk.relation.above_usual: This is more often favourable than usual for these dates here (2015-2024 reanalysis).
risk.relation.typical: This is within the usual range for these dates here (2015-2024 reanalysis).
risk.relation.below_usual: This is less often favourable than usual for these dates here (2015-2024 reanalysis).
uncertainty.differential: Signals of another problem ({names}) are also present; a reviewer should distinguish them.
uncertainty.healthy: The image also looks like a healthy leaf.
review.reason.differential: Another condition with similar signs may be present; an expert can tell them apart.
uncertainty.specific_low_certainty: A specific sign of coffee leaf rust was reported, but with low certainty (evidence score {score}). Confirm it on more leaves before acting.
review.reason.specific_low_certainty: A specific sign was reported with low certainty; an expert should confirm before decisions.
risk.climatology_caveat: The long-term baseline uses a different weather dataset than the current period, so this comparison is only indicative.
recommendation.count_spots_threshold: Count rust spots on a sample of leaves. Rwandan extension guidance (2012) considers control when there are about two spots per leaf; discuss with your extension officer before acting.
recommendation.open_canopy_spacing_pruni: Keep recommended tree spacing and prune to open the bush. In a 2012 Rwandan farm survey, pruned, mulched and fertilised farms had less rust, and intercropped farms more (an association, not proof of cause).
regional.rwanda_survey_context: Rwanda (2012 survey of 307 farms, dry season): rust in all provinces, worst in Eastern Province; less rust on farms above about 1800 m and more below about 1400 m; all commercial varieties then grown were susceptible.
regional.match_note.rwanda_approx: Shown because the location falls in an approximate Rwanda area (a rough box that also covers border areas of neighbouring countries); based on 2012 sources.
map.location_too_coarse: Location is only known to about {radius_m} m, too coarse for plant-level scouting; walk the whole plot instead.
map.limitations_uncertain: Relative scouting priority (0-1) around reported points; not an infection probability. Uncalibrated distance decay and wind stretch. Location known to about {radius_m} m, so cells are {cell_m} m.
